'''Jared Cunningham''' is an American basketball player, most recently playing for the [[Oregon State Beavers]].
==High School==
In his junior season at [[San Leandro High School]], Jared averaged 17.8 points, 4.5 rebounds and 3.3 assists per game. As a senior, Jared averaged 20.4 points, 6.3 rebounds and 2.6 assists per game. He earned academic All-America honors his senior year and was also ranked as the No. 14 guard and No. 76 overall player by [[Rivals.com]].<ref name=OSUbio />
==College career==
===Freshman season===
In Jared's freshman season at [[Oregon State University]], he averaged 6.2 points, 2.0 rebounds, and 0.9 assists per game. In a first round game against [[Boston University Terriers|Boston University]] in the [[2010 College Basketball Invitational]], Jared recorded a then career-high of 21 points.<ref name=OSUbio>{{cite web|title=Jared Cunningham Profile|url=http://www.osubeavers.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/cunningham_jared00.html|work=osubeavers.com|accessdate=27 June 2012}}</ref>
===Sophomore season===
In his sophomore season, Jared averaged 14.2 points, 3.1 rebounds, 2.1 assists and 2.83 steals per game. He was first in the Pac-10 in steals and was also fifth in the nation.  Jared was named to the All-Pac-10 Second Team and the Pac-10 All-Defensive-Team. Jared was also named to the Pac-10 All-Tournament Team after averaging 23.5 points per game in the [[2011 Pacific-10 Conference Men's Basketball Tournament]].<ref name=OSUbio />
===Junior season===
In Jared's junior season, he averaged 17.9 points, 3.8 rebounds, 2.8 assists and 2.53 steals per game. He led the [[Pac-12]] in steals per game for the second consecutive season, and also finished ninth nationally. Jared was also named to the All-Pac-12 First Team and the Pac-12 All-Defensive Team. Additionally, Jared was named tp the Pac-12 All-Tournament team for the second consecutive season.<ref name=OSUbio /> On April 9, 2012 Jared declared for the [[2012 NBA Draft]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Jared Cunningham Declares For NBA Draft|url=http://www.osubeavers.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/040912aab.html|work=osubeavers.com|accessdate=27 June 2012}}</ref>
